function makeCPU(){cpu=new MCS51(FW,{portRead:(p,l)=>p===1?slider:(p===3?0xff:l),xread,xwrite});dmBytes=[];lastCmd=null;cmdCount=0;lcdAddr=0;lcdDD.fill(32);ledByte=0xff;renderLCD();renderLEDs();$('cpuStat').textContent='BOOTING 80C31';$('cpuStat').className='warn'}
function signed8(b){return b<128?b:b-256}
function decodeVoice(ptr){if(pcmCache.has(ptr))return pcmCache.get(ptr);let pos=ptr>>>0,shift=8,out=[],guard=0;while(pos<SOUND.length&&guard++<SOUND.length){let s=signed8(SOUND[pos++]);if(s===-128){let n=1;if(shift>0)shift--;while(pos<SOUND.length&&signed8(SOUND[pos])===-128){pos++;n++;if(n>=3){const f=Float32Array.from(out);pcmCache.set(ptr,f);return f}}continue}out.push(-(s*(1<<shift))/32768)}const f=Float32Array.from(out);pcmCache.set(ptr,f);return f}
function unlockAudio(){try{const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;if(!AC)return;if(!audioCtx||audioCtx.state==='closed')audioCtx=new AC();if(audioCtx.state!=='running')audioCtx.resume();const b=audioCtx.createBuffer(1,1,48000),s=audioCtx.createBufferSource();s.buffer=b;s.connect(audioCtx.destination);s.start(0);audioUnlocked=true;$('audStat').textContent='UNLOCKED / FIRMWARE DM3AG';$('audStat').className='good'}catch(e){$('audStat').textContent='WEB AUDIO BLOCKED';$('audStat').className='warn'}}
function playDM(ptr){if(!audioCtx||!audioUnlocked||ptr<=0)return;const pcm=decodeVoice(ptr);if(!pcm.length)return;const b=audioCtx.createBuffer(1,pcm.length,48000);b.copyToChannel(pcm,0);const s=audioCtx.createBufferSource(),g=audioCtx.createGain();s.buffer=b;g.gain.value=.78;s.connect(g);g.connect(audioCtx.destination);s.start()}
function dmWrite(v){dmBytes.push(v&255);if(dmBytes.length<5)return;const c=dmBytes.splice(0,5),ptr=(c[0]<<12)|(c[1]<<4)|(c[2]>>4);lastCmd={c,ptr,low:c[2]&15,vol:c[3],pan:(c[4]>>5)&7,out:(c[4]&0x10)?1:2};cmdCount++;if(ptr>0)playDM(ptr);updateDebug()}
function updateDebug(){if(!cpu)return;const pc=cpu.pc.toString(16).padStart(4,'0').toUpperCase();let d=`PC $${pc}   machine cycles ${cpu.cycles.toLocaleString()}   DM3AG packets ${cmdCount}`;if(lastCmd)d+=`\nDM3AG ${lastCmd.c.map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0').toUpperCase()).join(' ')} → ROM $${lastCmd.ptr.toString(16).padStart(5,'0').toUpperCase()}  rawTune=${lastCmd.low} rawVol=$${lastCmd.vol.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')} panBits=${lastCmd.pan} out=${lastCmd.out}`;$('debug').textContent=d}
function runCycles(n){const end=cpu.cycles+n;let guard=0;try{while(cpu.cycles<end&&guard++<n*2+1000)cpu.step()}catch(e){running=false;$('cpuStat').textContent='CPU ERROR';$('cpuStat').className='warn';$('debug').textContent='CPU ERROR: '+e.message+'\n'+$('debug').textContent;console.error(e)}}
function frame(t){if(running){const dt=Math.min(0.05,(t-lastFrame)/1000);lastFrame=t;cycleDebt+=dt*1000000;const todo=Math.min(50000,cycleDebt|0);if(todo>0){runCycles(todo);cycleDebt-=todo}if(cpu.cycles>2500000){$('cpuStat').textContent='RUNNING REAL OS';$('cpuStat').className='good'}if((frame.count++&7)===0)updateDebug()}requestAnimationFrame(frame)}frame.count=0;
function pressMatrix(col,bit,el){unlockAudio();columns[col]&=~(1<<bit);el&&el.classList.add('down');setTimeout(()=>{columns[col]|=(1<<bit);el&&el.classList.remove('down')},85)}
function buildUI(){const lr=$('ledrow');ledNames.forEach(n=>{const e=document.createElement('span');e.className='led';e.textContent=n;lr.appendChild(e)});for(let c=0;c<4;c++)for(let b=0;b<8;b++){const e=document.createElement('button');e.className='ctrl';e.textContent=MATRIX[c][b];e.onclick=()=>pressMatrix(c,b,e);$('controls').appendChild(e)}for(let c=4;c<6;c++)for(let b=0;b<8;b++){const e=document.createElement('button');e.className='pad';e.textContent=MATRIX[c][b];e.onclick=()=>pressMatrix(c,b,e);$('pads').appendChild(e)}}
$('slider').oninput=e=>{slider=+e.target.value;$('sliderv').textContent=slider};$('resetBtn').onclick=()=>{unlockAudio();makeCPU();lastFrame=performance.now();cycleDebt=0;running=true};buildUI();makeCPU();requestAnimationFrame(frame);
</script>

const P2_PADS=['TOM 1','TOM 2','TOM 3','TOM 4','RIDE','CRASH','PERC 1','PERC 2','KICK','SNARE','CLOSED HAT','MID HAT','OPEN HAT','CLAPS','PERC 3','PERC 4'];

let p2Pattern=Object.fromEntries(P2_PADS.map(n=>[n,Array(32).fill(0)]));
let p2Ratchets=Object.fromEntries(P2_PADS.map(n=>[n,{}]));
let p2Length=32,p2Playing=false,p2Step=0,p2Next=0,p2PumpTimer=0,p2Generation=0,p2Current=null,p2Filter='all';
const p2Mix=Object.fromEntries(P2_PADS.map(n=>[n,{mute:false,level:1,pan:0}]));
let p2Master=.85,p2PadQueue=[];
function p2Coord(name){for(let c=0;c<MATRIX.length;c++){const b=MATRIX[c].indexOf(name);if(b>=0)return[c,b]}return null}
function p2QueuePad(name){p2PadQueue.push({name,t:performance.now()});if(p2PadQueue.length>32)p2PadQueue.shift()}
function p2Pulse(name,hold=18){const mix=p2Mix[name];if(mix?.mute)return;const q=p2Coord(name);if(!q)return;p2QueuePad(name);const[c,b]=q;columns[c]&=~(1<<b);setTimeout(()=>{columns[c]|=(1<<b)},hold)}
const p2BasePress=pressMatrix;pressMatrix=function(c,b,el){if(c>=4)p2QueuePad(MATRIX[c][b]);return p2BasePress(c,b,el)};
// Upgrade Phase-1 ROM playback with master and per-pad mix without bypassing firmware-generated DM3AG commands.
playDM=function(ptr){if(!audioCtx||!audioUnlocked||ptr<=0)return;const sound=p7ResolveHit();if(sound.skip)return;const pcm=sound.choice?p7Decode(sound.choice):decodeVoice(ptr);if(!pcm.length)return;const cfg=sound.pad?p2Mix[sound.pad]:null;const b=audioCtx.createBuffer(1,pcm.length,48000);b.copyToChannel(pcm,0);const s=audioCtx.createBufferSource(),g=audioCtx.createGain();s.buffer=b;g.gain.value=.78*p2Master*(cfg?cfg.level:1);if(audioCtx.createStereoPanner){const pan=audioCtx.createStereoPanner();pan.pan.value=cfg?cfg.pan:0;s.connect(g);g.connect(pan);pan.connect(audioCtx.destination)}else{s.connect(g);g.connect(audioCtx.destination)}s.start()};
function p2Switch(view){document.querySelectorAll('.p2view').forEach(v=>v.classList.toggle('active',v.dataset.p2view===view));document.querySelectorAll('#p2nav button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.view===view));window.scrollTo(0,0);if(view==='settings')p2UpdateDiag()}
function p2BuildNav(){const n=document.getElementById('p2nav');[['machine','MACHINE'],['patterns','PATTERNS'],['mixer','MIXER'],['voices','VOICES'],['settings','SETTINGS'],['legacy','LEGACY STUDIO']].forEach(([v,l],i)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=l;b.dataset.view=v;b.classList.toggle('active',i===0);b.onclick=()=>p2Switch(v);n.appendChild(b)})}
function p2StepDur(step){const bpm=+document.getElementById('p2Bpm').value||120,a=(+document.getElementById('p2Swing').value||0)/100,pair=(60/bpm)/2;return 1000*pair*((step&1)?(0.5-0.25*a):(0.5+0.25*a))}
function p2Fire(step,dur,gen){if(!p2Playing||gen!==p2Generation)return;for(const n of P2_PADS){if(p2Pattern[n][step]){p2Pulse(n);const r=+(p2Ratchets[n][step]||1);if(r>1){for(let j=1;j<r;j++)setTimeout(()=>{if(p2Playing&&gen===p2Generation)p2Pulse(n,10)},dur*j/r)}}}document.querySelectorAll('.p2step.playhead').forEach(e=>e.classList.remove('playhead'));document.querySelectorAll(`.p2step[data-step="${step}"]`).forEach(e=>e.classList.add('playhead'))}
function p2Pump(){if(!p2Playing)return;const gen=p2Generation,now=performance.now(),look=110;let guard=0;while(p2Next<now+look&&guard++<12){const st=p2Step,dur=p2StepDur(st),due=p2Next;setTimeout(()=>p2Fire(st,dur,gen),Math.max(0,due-performance.now()));p2Next+=dur;p2Step=(p2Step+1)%p2Length}p2PumpTimer=setTimeout(p2Pump,20)}
function p2Play(){unlockAudio();if(p2Playing)return;p2Playing=true;p2Generation++;p2Step=0;p2Next=performance.now()+60;document.getElementById('p2PatternStatus').textContent=(p2Current?`${p2Current.artist} — ${p2Current.title} — ${p2Current.section}`:'Custom pattern')+' • PLAYING THROUGH HR-16 FIRMWARE';p2Pump()}
function p2Stop(){p2Playing=false;p2Generation++;clearTimeout(p2PumpTimer);document.querySelectorAll('.p2step.playhead').forEach(e=>e.classList.remove('playhead'));const s=document.getElementById('p2PatternStatus');if(s)s.textContent=(p2Current?`${p2Current.artist} — ${p2Current.title} — ${p2Current.section}`:'Custom pattern')+' • STOPPED'}
function p2Clear(){p2Stop();for(const n of P2_PADS){p2Pattern[n].fill(0);p2Ratchets[n]={}}p2Current=null;p2RenderGrid()}
function p2RenderGrid(){const g=document.getElementById('p2Grid');g.innerHTML='';g.style.gridTemplateColumns=`92px repeat(${p2Length},24px)`;const x=document.createElement('div');x.className='lab';x.textContent='PAD';g.appendChild(x);for(let s=0;s<p2Length;s++){const h=document.createElement('div');h.className='num'+(s===16?' p2bar':'');h.textContent=s+1;g.appendChild(h)}for(const n of P2_PADS){const l=document.createElement('div');l.className='lab';l.textContent=n;g.appendChild(l);for(let s=0;s<p2Length;s++){const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='p2step'+(p2Pattern[n][s]===1?' on':p2Pattern[n][s]===2?' accent':'')+(s===16?' p2bar':'');b.dataset.pad=n;b.dataset.step=s;b.title=`${n} step ${s+1}`;b.onclick=()=>{p2Pattern[n][s]=(p2Pattern[n][s]+1)%3;b.className='p2step'+(p2Pattern[n][s]===1?' on':p2Pattern[n][s]===2?' accent':'')+(s===16?' p2bar':'')};g.appendChild(b)}}}
function p2LoadPattern(p,play=false){p2Stop();p2Length=[16,32].includes(+p.length)?+p.length:32;document.getElementById('p2Len').value=String(p2Length);for(const n of P2_PADS){p2Pattern[n].fill(0);p2Ratchets[n]={}}for(const [role,steps] of Object.entries(p.roles||{})){const n=P2_ROLE[role.toLowerCase()];if(!n)continue;for(const s of steps)if(s<32)p2Pattern[n][s]=1}for(const [role,steps] of Object.entries(p.accents||{})){const n=P2_ROLE[role.toLowerCase()];if(!n)continue;for(const s of steps)if(s<32)p2Pattern[n][s]=2}for(const [role,map] of Object.entries(p.ratchets||{})){const n=P2_ROLE[role.toLowerCase()];if(!n)continue;for(const [s,r] of Object.entries(map))p2Ratchets[n][+s]=+r}if(p.bpm){document.getElementById('p2Bpm').value=p.bpm;document.getElementById('p2BpmV').textContent=p.bpm}p2Current=p;p2RenderGrid();const st=document.getElementById('p2PatternStatus');st.textContent=`${p.artist} — ${p.title} — ${p.section} • ${p2Length} STEPS • ${p.bpm||120} BPM`;p2Switch('patterns');if(play)setTimeout(p2Play,40)}
function p2GroupPatterns(){const m=new Map();for(const p of P2_PATTERNS){const k=p.songGroup||`${p.artist}__${p.title}`;if(!m.has(k))m.set(k,[]);m.get(k).push(p)}return [...m.values()].map(a=>a.sort((x,y)=>(x.sectionOrder||0)-(y.sectionOrder||0)))}
function p2RenderBrowser(){const host=document.getElementById('p2Browser');host.innerHTML='';const q=(document.getElementById('p2Search')?.value||'').toLowerCase();for(const group of p2GroupPatterns()){const p=group[0],hay=(group.map(x=>`${x.artist} ${x.title} ${x.section} ${x.genre}`).join(' ')).toLowerCase();if(p2Filter!=='all'&&!hay.includes(p2Filter))continue;if(q&&!hay.includes(q))continue;const c=document.createElement('div');c.className='p2card';c.innerHTML=`<h3>${p.title}</h3><div class="meta">${p.artist}</div><span class="p2badge">${p.genre||'pattern'}</span><span class="p2badge">${p.bpm||120} BPM</span>`;let sel=null;if(group.length>1){sel=document.createElement('select');for(const x of group){const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=x.id;o.textContent=x.section;sel.appendChild(o)}c.appendChild(sel)}else{const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='meta';d.style.marginTop='6px';d.textContent=p.section;c.appendChild(d)}const a=document.createElement('div');a.className='actions';for(const [label,play] of [['LOAD',false],['LOAD + PLAY',true]]){const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=label;b.onclick=()=>{const id=sel?sel.value:p.id;p2LoadPattern(P2_PATTERNS.find(x=>x.id===id),play)};a.appendChild(b)}c.appendChild(a);host.appendChild(c)}}
function p2BuildFilters(){const f=document.getElementById('p2Filters');const s=document.createElement('input');s.id='p2Search';s.placeholder='Search patterns…';s.style.minWidth='150px';s.oninput=p2RenderBrowser;f.appendChild(s);for(const [v,l] of [['all','ALL'],['industrial','INDUSTRIAL'],['electronic','ELECTRONIC'],['hip-hop','HIP-HOP'],['idm','IDM / APHEX'],['dnb','DNB / JUNGLE']]){const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='p2filter'+(v==='all'?' active':'');b.textContent=l;b.onclick=()=>{p2Filter=v;document.querySelectorAll('.p2filter').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));b.classList.add('active');p2RenderBrowser()};f.appendChild(b)}}
function p2BuildMixer(){const h=document.getElementById('p2Mixer');for(const n of P2_PADS){const r=document.createElement('div');r.className='p2mixrow';r.innerHTML=`<div class="name">${n}</div>`;const mute=document.createElement('button');mute.textContent='MUTE';mute.onclick=()=>{p2Mix[n].mute=!p2Mix[n].mute;mute.classList.toggle('on',p2Mix[n].mute)};r.appendChild(mute);const lev=document.createElement('label');lev.innerHTML='<span>LEVEL</span>';const li=document.createElement('input');li.type='range';li.min=0;li.max=100;li.value=100;const lv=document.createElement('b');lv.textContent='100';li.oninput=()=>{p2Mix[n].level=+li.value/100;lv.textContent=li.value};lev.append(li,lv);r.appendChild(lev);const pan=document.createElement('label');pan.innerHTML='<span>PAN</span>';const pi=document.createElement('input');pi.type='range';pi.min=-100;pi.max=100;pi.value=0;const pv=document.createElement('b');pv.textContent='0';pi.oninput=()=>{p2Mix[n].pan=+pi.value/100;pv.textContent=pi.value};pan.append(pi,pv);r.appendChild(pan);h.appendChild(r)}}
function p2BuildVoices(){const h=document.getElementById('p2Voices');for(const n of P2_PADS){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='p2voice';const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=n;b.onclick=()=>{unlockAudio();p2Pulse(n,55)};d.appendChild(b);d.appendChild(p7PadChangeButton(n));h.appendChild(d)}document.querySelectorAll('[data-fwshortcut]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const q=p2Coord(b.dataset.fwshortcut);if(q)pressMatrix(q[0],q[1],b)})}
function p2Save(){const o={format:'HR16-Firmware-Studio-Pattern',version:1,length:p2Length,bpm:+document.getElementById('p2Bpm').value,swing:+document.getElementById('p2Swing').value,pattern:p2Pattern,ratchets:p2Ratchets,padAssignments:p7Selections};const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(o,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='HR16_firmware_pattern.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),500)}
function p2LoadFile(file){const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{try{const o=JSON.parse(r.result);p2Stop();p2Length=[16,32].includes(+o.length)?+o.length:32;document.getElementById('p2Len').value=p2Length;for(const n of P2_PADS){p2Pattern[n]=Array(32).fill(0);for(let i=0;i<Math.min(32,o.pattern?.[n]?.length||0);i++)p2Pattern[n][i]=o.pattern[n][i]||0;p2Ratchets[n]=o.ratchets?.[n]||{}}if(o.bpm)document.getElementById('p2Bpm').value=o.bpm;if(o.swing!=null)document.getElementById('p2Swing').value=o.swing;document.getElementById('p2BpmV').textContent=document.getElementById('p2Bpm').value;document.getElementById('p2SwingV').textContent=document.getElementById('p2Swing').value+'%';p2Current=null;if(o.padAssignments)p7RestoreSelections(o.padAssignments);p2RenderGrid();p2Switch('patterns')}catch(e){alert('Pattern load failed: '+e.message)}};r.readAsText(file)}
function p2UpdateDiag(){const e=document.getElementById('p2Diag');if(!e)return;e.textContent=`CPU PC $${cpu?cpu.pc.toString(16).padStart(4,'0').toUpperCase():'----'} • ${cpu?cpu.cycles.toLocaleString():0} machine cycles • ${cmdCount} DM3AG packets • Audio ${audioCtx?.state||'locked'} • Enhanced ${p2Playing?'PLAYING':'stopped'} • Pattern ${p2Current?p2Current.title:'custom'}`}
function p2Init(){p2BuildNav();p2BuildFilters();p2RenderBrowser();p2BuildMixer();p2BuildVoices();p2RenderGrid();document.getElementById('p2Play').onclick=p2Play;document.getElementById('p2Stop').onclick=p2Stop;document.getElementById('p2Clear').onclick=p2Clear;document.getElementById('p2Bpm').oninput=e=>document.getElementById('p2BpmV').textContent=e.target.value;document.getElementById('p2Swing').oninput=e=>document.getElementById('p2SwingV').textContent=e.target.value+'%';document.getElementById('p2Len').onchange=e=>{p2Length=+e.target.value;p2RenderGrid()};document.getElementById('p2Master').oninput=e=>{p2Master=+e.target.value/100;document.getElementById('p2MasterV').textContent=e.target.value+'%'};document.getElementById('p2Unmute').onclick=()=>{for(const n of P2_PADS)p2Mix[n].mute=false;document.querySelectorAll('.p2mixrow button').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('on'))};document.getElementById('p2Save').onclick=p2Save;document.getElementById('p2LoadBtn').onclick=()=>document.getElementById('p2Load').click();document.getElementById('p2Load').onchange=e=>e.target.files[0]&&p2LoadFile(e.target.files[0]);setInterval(p2UpdateDiag,1000)}
setTimeout(p2Init,0);
</script>

<script id="phase3-three-real-firmware">
const PH3_FW_HR16=FW, PH3_SOUND_HR16=SOUND;
const PH3_FW_HR16B=b64('');
const PH3_FW_SR16=b64('');
const PH3_SOUND_HR16B=b64('
